events.title: Thai Stock Market Called Lower Again On Thursday
events.description: The Thai stock market has finished lower in three straight sessions, sinking almost 50 points or 3.1 percent along the way. The Stock Exchange of Thailand now sits just beneath the 1,560-point plateau and it's expected to see continued consolidation on Thursday.

events.title: Japanese Market Sharply Higher
events.description: The Japanese market is trading sharply higher on Thursday, extending the gains in the previous session, following the mixed cues from Wall Street overnight. The Nikkei 225 is moving well above the 67,700 level, with gains in index heavyweights and technology stocks partially offset by weakness in automakers and financial stocks.

events.title: Losing Streak May Continue For Indonesia Stock Market
events.description: The Indonesia stock market has finished lower in five straight sessions, tumbling more than 300 points or 4.4 percent along the way. The Jakarta Composite Index now sits just above the 6,070-point plateau and it's expected to open under water again on Thursday.

events.title: Australian Market Significantly Lower
events.description: The Australian market is trading significantly lower on Thursday, snapping a three-session winning streak, following the mixed cues from Wall Street overnight. The benchmark S&P/ASX 200 is falling below the 8,700 level, with weakness across most sectors led by mining and financial stocks.

events.title: Indonesia Manufacturing Sector Climbs Into Expansion - S&P Global
events.description: The manufacturing sector in Indonesia moved back up into expansion territory in September, the latest survey from S&P Global revealed on Thursday with a manufacturing PMI score of 52.4.

events.title: Japan Manufacturing Sector Ebbs In September - S&P Global
events.description: The manufacturing sector in Japan continued to expand in September, albeit at a slower rate, the latest survey from S&P Global revealed on Thursday with a manufacturing PMI score of 54.1.

events.title: Vietnam Manufacturing Sector Slows In September - S&P Global
events.description: The manufacturing sector in Vietnam continued to expand in September, albeit at a slower rate, the latest survey from S&P Global revealed on Thursday with a manufacturing PMI score of 51.9.

events.title: Thai Manufacturing Sector Strengthens In September - S&P Global
events.description: The manufacturing sector in Thailand continued to expand in September, and at a faster rate, the latest survey from S&P Global revealed on Thursday with a manufacturing PMI score of 54.3.

events.title: Taiwan Manufacturing Sector Picks Up Steam In September - S&P Global
events.description: The manufacturing sector in Taiwan continued to expand in September, and at a faster rate, the latest survey from S&P Global revealed on Thursday with a manufacturing PMI score of 56.7.

events.title: South Korea Manufacturing Sector Accelerates In September - S&P Global
events.description: The manufacturing sector in South Korea continued to expand in September, and at a faster rate, the latest survey from S&P Global revealed on Thursday with a manufacturing PMI score of 53.9.

events.title: Philippines Manufacturing PMI Sinks To 49.6 - S&P Global
events.description: The manufacturing sector in the Philippines dropped into contraction territory in September, the latest survey from S&P Global revealed on Thursday with a manufacturing PMI score of 49.6.

events.title: Malaysia Manufacturing Sector Contracts In September - S&P Global
events.description: The manufacturing sector in Malaysia sank into contraction territory in September, the latest survey from S&P Global revealed on Thursday with a manufacturing PMI score of 49.9.

events.title: Taiwan Stock Market May Spin Its Wheels On Thursday
events.description: The Taiwan stock market on Wednesday snapped the two-day losing streak in which it had given up more than 525 points or 1.2 percent. The Taiwan Stock Exchange now sits just above the 47,940-point plateau although it may be stuck in neutral on Thursday.
